name: ci_step_ordering
title: 'git add <path>' before path exists causes 'fatal: pathspec'
symptom: A CI step fails with 'fatal: pathspec' even though the file is generated later in the pipeline
cause: The commit step runs before the step that generates the file it tries to add
fix: Reorder steps: generate the artifact FIRST, then commit it. Verify the file exists before git add.
mal_code:
# commit step before generation step
- name: Commit
  run: git add docs/report.md  # file not created yet
good_code:
- name: Generate report
  run: python gen.py
- name: Commit
  run: git add docs/report.md
